message.content: No clang, but gcc supports ASan. Let me rebuild the libxml2 library with gcc + ASan, then build a standalone xpath harness driver.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -E \"^(CC|CFLAGS|CPPFLAGS|LDFLAGS|LIBS|DEFS|top_builddir|srcdir|top_srcdir|INCLUDES|AM_CFLAGS|EXTRA_CFLAGS|THREAD_CFLAGS|Z_CFLAGS|LZMA_CFLAGS|RDL_LIBS|WITH_LIBS|LIBXML2_LIBS) *=\" Makefile | head -40; echo \"---includes---\"; grep -E \"INCLUDES|DEFAULT_INCLUDES|AM_CPPFLAGS\" Makefile | head"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
CC = clang
CFLAGS = -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address
CPPFLAGS =
DEFS = -DHAVE_CONFIG_H
EXTRA_CFLAGS =  -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Wshadow -Wpointer-arith -Wcast-align -Wwrite-strings -Waggregate-return -Wstrict-prototypes -Wmissing-prototypes -Wnested-externs -Winline -Wredundant-decls -Wno-long-long -Wno-format-extra-args
LDFLAGS =
LIBS =
LZMA_CFLAGS =
RDL_LIBS =
THREAD_CFLAGS =  -D_REENTRANT
Z_CFLAGS =
srcdir = .
top_builddir = .
top_srcdir = .
AM_CFLAGS = $(EXTRA_CFLAGS) $(THREAD_CFLAGS) $(Z_CFLAGS) $(LZMA_CFLAGS)
---includes---
DEFAULT_INCLUDES = -I.
COMPILE = $(CC) $(DEFS) $(DEFAULT_INCLUDES) $(INCLUDES) $(AM_CPPFLAGS) \
        $(DEFAULT_INCLUDES) $(INCLUDES) $(AM_CPPFLAGS) $(CPPFLAGS) \
PYTHON_INCLUDES =
AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(top_builddir)/include -I$(srcdir)/include
